rebecca_cs: Heads-up: customer kickoff in 6h. They want a 1-page handout for infra that covers prefill, safe batching, KV cache tips, streaming hygiene, 72h watchlist, and 3-step mitigations. Keep it ops-friendly and copy/pasteable.
om_se: I'll draft a compact handout. No internal flags, only hosted/dedicated knobs.
tao_sre: Please include a short degraded flow ops can run without eng and two quick validation commands.
miguel_support: I'll add the top customer questions (one-liners).
anya_pm: Add a one-line renewal escalation: if 2 watchlist signals in 72h -> urgent review.
om_se: Draft (one-pager copy):
"Ops Handoff: Fieldplay Cheat Sheet"
- Prefill: ramp 12% of active users for 20m (jitter start times) to seed KV cache; record baseline tokens/day.
- Prefill snippet (copy/paste):
for i in $(seq 1 120); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":64,"metadata":{"prefill":true}}' & done; wait
- Batching: short prompts (<70 tokens) -> target_batch_size=22, max_wait_ms=25. Long outputs -> target_batch_size=4.
- KV cache: enable prefix_cache, prefer prefix_ttl=300s for interactive; 45s for high-churn. Aim for prefix_cache_hit_rate >35% after prefill.
- Streaming: enable when average output >500 tokens; set keepalive_s=12 and socket_timeout_ms=45k to reduce mobile stalls.
- 72h watchlist: P95 > SLO for >2h, tokens/day +40% vs baseline for 24h, sustained 5xx >1% for 30m.
- Fast mitigations (ops order): 1) Failover region; 2) Halve batch size + reduce max_generation_tokens by 25%; 3) Switch to compact fallback model.
- Validation (copy/paste):
1) KV hit: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.com/v1/metrics?name=prefix_cache_hit_rate
2) Warm vs cold median: run 30 warm requests and 30 cold requests, compare medians.
- What to send support: sample request JSON, route.name, account_id, X-Request-ID, prompt_hash, timestamps.
- FAQs (one-liners):
Q: Why did tokens spike? A: Often repeated full prompts or verbose per-request system text; enable client dedupe + prefill.
Q: Streaming stalls on mobile? A: Increase keepalive and confirm proxies/LBs allow long-lived connections.
Q: How to limit spend during pilot? A: Use daily_token_limit + per-minute caps and alert at 60%.
anya_pm: Escalation: if two watchlist signals fire within 72h tag ticket cs:fieldplay-review; CS+Eng will run a config audit and offer short-term protections.
ops_bot: ops_bot: Draft saved to /portal-drafts/cs/fieldplay-handoff-v1 (preview).
rebecca_cs: Thanks — I'll convert to PDF/HTML and attach to the kickoff email. Owner: rebecca_cs. Due: tomorrow 9am PT.
